simple.meaning: אוֹ (ʼôw) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “desire (and so probably in Proverbs 31:4); hence (by way of alternative) or , also if.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 321 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, beginning at Genesis 24:49. Its contexts include birth, family, family line, flock, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אוֹ (H176).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
